semiconductor_relevance: High — METIS Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor equipment and control systems, particularly for LCD and robotics applications.
summary: METIS Co., Ltd. has been a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector since 1999, focusing on the development of LCD equipment control systems and robotic motion controllers. The company emphasizes quality control management, technology development, and cost reduction to enhance productivity in semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.Korea: METIS has achieved rapid growth among the leading companies in Korea.
